_doc: Native type signatures for the `upgrade` command. Discovered usage from the protodef json is merged on top of these entries, so this file only needs to declare what cannot be inferred from a use site (e.g. a native used without all of its arguments in a given protocol, or purely-semantic params). `args` are value (lowercase) parameters, `generics` are type (uppercase) parameters, `value_generic` declares the chained `=> T` element type.
